playtest_evidence.claim_scope: executability and termination only; not balance or fun

turn: place one signal in any empty inner or outer well
rotate the outer orbit exactly one notch clockwise or counterclockwise
check the occupied inner station and its two currently framed outer wells for a wedge
design.win_condition: a three-signal wedge wins; if both players complete one on the same move, the mover wins
wish_features: five inner stations are the five Workshop jobs
the shared rotating orbit changes adjacency after every placement
opposition is literal interference with a surviving alignment plan
